evals.name: cards-feel-boring
evals.prompt: the project cards feel kinda boring and generic, make them cooler
evals.expected_output: A redesign-preserve prompt for ProjectCard/ProjectGrid that keeps the reticle identity, decodes 'cooler' into a concrete Goal 2 interaction or hierarchy move, and drives design-taste-frontend with the site's overrides.

evals.name: project-premium
evals.prompt: make the project pages feel more premium, rn they're basically just a wall of text
evals.expected_output: A redesign prompt for ProjectLayout/project components that treats 'premium' as restraint and 'wall of text' as layer-cake/progressive disclosure, never invents media, and keeps Problem/Approach/What I built/Outcome.

evals.name: bento-under-hero
evals.prompt: add something sick right under the hero that shows off my skills, like one of those bento grid things with stats and stuff
evals.expected_output: A new-surface prompt that refuses invented stats (fact-only), steers stats to real readouts, N items = N cells, and flags the conflict with existing sections/capabilities rather than duplicating them.
